# Multilingual ticket router

*Client industry: travel | Completed: 2024-09-12 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p14*

## The problem
The client was a travel agency routing Arabic, Urdu and English tickets.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, pretrained transformer checkpoints, FastAPI, containerised deployment. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project routed 90% of tickets to the right queue.
